A nice lunch
Jul 2025 • Business
I had lunch today at Saju Restaurant with my colleague, and it was an impressive experience overall.
The food was nicely presented and delicious. The seaweed salad with roe was a bit on the salty side, but the salmon sashimi was incredibly fresh. The grilled salmon rolls topped with unagi were savory and well-balanced.
Service was okay, and the staff made the atmosphere feel comfortable and relaxed.
One small suggestion: it would be great if the door sensor could be adjusted closer to the entrance. We were seated at a table near the door, and every time someone walked by, the automatic door opened that making the area a bit warm.
All in all, I highly recommend Saju to anyone looking for affordable and quality Japanese cuisine in the Cau Giay District.
